### Contributing guidelines

- [x] I reproduced this on latest version of the `main` branch

### Neovim version

0.11.x

### Description

Hello again @echasnovski, I was trying to import a C++ snippet to MiniMax. When expanding a snippet the places where $1 is there are 2 unknown characters appear. One is like a dot and another is a square. both don't want to get deleted nor copy-able. And after some time still editing text I get this warning message from mini.notify:
```
    (mini.snippets) Session contains corrupted data (deleted or out of range extmarks). It is stopped.
```

Weirdly, after closing and re-opening the file the characters no longer exist.
Thanks.

### Reproduction

1. create a file at `~/.config/nvim/snippets/cpp.json`
2. add the following to the file:
```json
{
    "competitive-programming": {
        "prefix": "cp",
        "body": [
            "#include <bits/stdc++.h>",
            "using namespace std;",
            "",
            "#define _vec vector",
            "#define _be(_a) _a.begin(), _a.end()",
            "#define _rbe(_a) _a.rbegin(), _a.rend()",
            "",
            "typedef long long int lli;",
            "typedef long long unsigned int llu;",
            "",
            "const int M = (int)1e9 + 7;",
            "",
            "template<typename T>",
            "void print_vec(const _vec<T> &v)",
            "{",
            "    for (const T &elem : v) {",
            "        cout << elem << \" \";",
            "    }",
            "    printf(\"\\n\");",
            "}",
            "",
            "inline bool sqrt_able(lli n)",
            "{",
            "    lli k = sqrtl((long double)n);",
            "    return k * k == n;",
            "}",
            "",
            "int main()",
            "{",
            "    $1",
            "",
            "    return 0;",
            "}"
        ]
    }
}
```
3. open a C++ file, and try to expand `cp` snippet.

comment_data.body:
Thanks for the issue!

> When expanding a snippet the places where $1 is there are 2 unknown characters appear. One is like a dot and another is a square. both don't want to get deleted nor copy-able.

This is an expected behavior described [here in MiniMax](https://github.com/nvim-mini/MiniMax/blob/c419b993bee83a3494d55ae7063b0cdbad5c5af5/configs/nvim-0.11/plugin/30_mini.lua#L699-L709) and at least [here in 'mini.nvim'](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/doc/mini-snippets.html#minisnippets-overview-expand). The symbols denote empty tabstops (dot for `$1`, square for automatically inserted final tabstop `$0`).

> And after some time still editing text I get this warning message from mini.notify:
> 
> ```
>     (mini.snippets) Session contains corrupted data (deleted or out of range extmarks). It is stopped.
> ```

This happens because there are actions that are [not recommended to do](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/ee4a4a4abed25e3d108d985b0553c5271f2f71aa/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L1118-L1123), namely too intrusive text editing outside of snippet session. The workflow with snippets is basically "Insert -> move through tabstops until final (small text edits outside of snippet are allowed in between jumps) -> stop (automatically or manually)".

title: [mini.snippets] unknown characters when expanding $1.
